items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My uncle taught me to play the bongos and my mom sang. So I imitated all of them.

ctx.x: And so he as a musician, was known to all of the members of these groups, so from a very young age, you were around professional musicians, right?

Yes, from my mom’s side and from my dad’s side. On my mom’s side, my uncles were all musicians. And on my dad’s side, he taught me to play the tres. My uncle taught me to play the bongos and my mom sang. So I imitated all of them. I wanted to be the one-man-band.
